The certificate estate that outlives every migration: what AD CS holds up and hardening what stays, the target of Cloud PKI, AD CS and Federal PKI, device and user certificates through Intune and Entra certificate-based authentication, PIV and derived PIV, coexistence, and a certificate lifecycle platform with monitoring and decommissioning.

Work down the page: understand the design, plan it, build it, learn it, watch it, download it, and keep the evidence. [All topics](index.md) lists the others.
